newsitem.title: DENMARK: Dutch Van Geel acquires Danish FLS unit.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Van Geel acquires Danish FLS unit.

text.p: Danish engineeering group FLS Industries A/S said on Thursday it sold its remaining 51 percent shareholding in partly-owned Dampa A/S to the Netherlands' Van Geel Metal B.V. for an undisclosed sum.
FLS said its Dampa A/S unit and Van Geel Metal established a joint venture in 1993, with the Van Geel Group acquiring a 49 percent share stake in the company and FLS holding 51 percent.
It said Dampa A/S would remain a Danish company with Van Geel becoming one of the world's leading manufacturers of metal roofing through the deal. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
